# Vendored browser dependencies

## SheetJS Community Edition

- File: `xlsx.full.min.js`
- Version: `0.20.3`
- Upstream: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- License: Apache-2.0
- MD5: `6b3130af1ceadf07caa0ec08af7addff`
- SHA-256: `cc015130aa8521e7f088f88898eba949ccdcbfb38df0bd129b44b7273c3a6f41`
- SRI: `sha256-zAFRMKqFIefwiPiImOupSczcv7ON8L0Sm0S3Jzw6b0E=`

The upstream CDN is blocked on some school networks, so the browser build is
served from this application's own origin. The committed bytes match the
checksum published for the official SheetJS 0.20.3 standalone build.

Do not replace this executable file without updating and independently
verifying the checksums and the `integrity` attribute in `section.html`.
